record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: For the case E ≠ K and a generic L-parameter M of U(V_K), prove the full local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture 8.3: multiplicity one for each π in Irr(U(V_K)); the packet identity that the total multiplicity summed over both skew-Hermitian spaces V and all π in the L-packet Π_M equals 1; an epsilon-factor formula characterizing the unique skew-Hermitian space V_0 that contributes; and an explicit character formula identifying the unique packet member π with nonzero contribution via the local component group A_M.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 8.3. (i) For each π ∈ Irr(U(V_K)), m_V(π, µ) = dim Hom_{U(V )}(π, ω_{V,ψ,µ}) ≤ 1. (ii) Let M be a generic L-parameter of U(V_K) ... Then Σ_V Σ_{π∈Π_M} m_V(π, µ) = 1 ... (iii) The unique V_0 which has nonzero contribution ... is characterized by ... (iv) The unique π ∈ Π_M which has nonzero contribution ... corresponds ... to the character of the local component group A_M ...

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F$ be a non-archimedean local field of characteristic zero, and let $E$ and $K$ be two distinct quadratic field extensions of $F$. Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional skew-Hermitian space over $E$, and set $V_K = V \otimes_F K$, regarded as a skew-Hermitian space over the compositum $EK$ relative to the involution induced from $E/F$. Denote by $U(V)$ and $U(V_K)$ the corresponding unitary groups, and view $U(V) \hookrightarrow U(V_K)$ via the natural embedding.

Fix a nontrivial additive character $\psi$ of $F$ and a conjugate-symplectic character $\mu$ of $E^\times$. Let $\omega_{V,\psi,\mu}$ denote the Weil representation of $U(V)$ associated with $(\psi,\mu)$. For $\pi \in \mathrm{Irr}(U(V_K))$, define the multiplicity
$$m_V(\pi,\mu) = \dim \mathrm{Hom}_{U(V)}(\pi, \omega_{V,\psi,\mu}).$$

Let $M$ be a generic $L$-parameter of $U(V_K)$, with local Vogan $L$-packet $\Pi_M$ (over the set of pure inner forms indexed by isomorphism classes of skew-Hermitian spaces $V$ of the given dimension), and let $A_M$ denote its local component group. Prove the following assertions:

(i) (Multiplicity one) For every $\pi \in \mathrm{Irr}(U(V_K))$, $m_V(\pi,\mu) \le 1$.

(ii) (Packet identity) $\displaystyle\sum_{V}\sum_{\pi \in \Pi_M} m_V(\pi,\mu) = 1$, where the outer sum is over isomorphism classes of skew-Hermitian spaces $V$ in the relevant Vogan packet.

(iii) (Epsilon-factor dichotomy) Identify the unique skew-Hermitian space $V_0$ for which some $\pi \in \Pi_M$ satisfies $m_{V_0}(\pi,\mu) \ne 0$ by an explicit local epsilon-factor criterion attached to $M$ and $\mu$.

(iv) (Character formula) Identify the unique $\pi \in \Pi_M$ with $m_{V_0}(\pi,\mu) = 1$ as the member of $\Pi_M$ corresponding, under the local Langlands correspondence for $U(V_K)$, to an explicit prescribed character of the component group $A_M$.
artifact.status_search_result: A recent preprint (Nhat Hoang Le, arXiv:2511.01301, 2025) announces a proof of the local twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for U(V_K)/U(V) for tempered L-parameters over non-archimedean local fields of odd residual characteristic, which covers a large portion of the generic (tempered) case of the E≠K conjecture. Full generic (not necessarily tempered) and archimedean cases do not appear to be settled in the literature as of May 2026, so the conjecture is best described as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for U(V_K)/U(V)
status_evidence.snippet: We prove the local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for U(V_K)/U(V) for tempered L-parameters over nonarchimedean fields of odd residual characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: The tempered case of the local twisted GGP conjecture in the E≠K setting is established for p-adic fields of odd residual characteristic.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for certain tempered L-packets
status_evidence.snippet: Twisted GGP conjecture proved for certain tempered L-packets.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress for tempered packets was made prior to 2025.
